metadata.title: Mónica P. Arroyo | Frontend Developer
metadata.description: Frontend Developer specialized in Next.js, TypeScript, React and PHP/Laravel. Portfolio, projects and blog.

hero.name: Mónica P. Arroyo
hero.desc: I build modern, accessible interfaces, understanding the product end to end.

projects.heading: works
projects.subheading: A selection of things I've built.

items.weddinghub: A single RSVP app for weddings: guest management, confirmations and a countdown, with authentication and an admin dashboard.
items.astroletras: Book catalog with search and global state.
items.contactapp: Full-stack contacts CRUD with form validation.
items.calaverita: Arduino library: senses distance and moves a jaw with sound and lights.
items.decoder: Combinational logic circuit that turns a binary (BCD) input into the pattern for a 7-segment display.
items.flanes: Browser game built with Phaser for 'Las flanes', my group of friends. A project close to my heart.

experience.heading: experience
experience.before: Before dev — STEAM educator: I taught Arduino and robotics at Instituto Francisco Possenti (2019–2022).

hirint.summary: I develop and scale the platform on a modern stack, after helping migrate the legacy architecture to Next.js and TypeScript.
highlights: Designed and shipped the Valoraciones (assessments) feature end to end — from the data model and Laravel logic to the final UI.
I maintain 15+ evaluation report types (web and PDF) with reusable components; optimized SQL queries for bulk exports.

yaganaste.summary: Revamped the UI with Next.js and TypeScript and helped split the frontend and backend.

snowballcommunity.summary: Led development of a social network for entrepreneurs and investors, bilingual (ES/EN) from day one.

snowballmx.summary: Ongoing development and improvement of a fintech crowdfunding platform.

about.heading: about
about.p1: Hi! I'm Mónica. A full-stack developer with 4+ years building modern web solutions. My strength is the React ecosystem —Next.js and TypeScript— but I move comfortably across the backend with Laravel, so I understand the product end to end.
about.p2: I love turning manual processes into efficient digital tools. Before becoming a dev I was a STEAM educator, which gave me clear communication, teamwork and creative problem-solving. I always look to add value beyond the code.
funFacts: I love electronics and tinkering with Arduino 🔌
